text: You just watch two jackpot symbols land, and the third one stopped one click short.
So, you move to the machine next door and the exact same thing happens.
Your buddy leans over and says,

text.text: So you put in another hundred.
Inside is a list of every place that last reel can stop.
The jackpot is on that list once.
One click short is on there over and over.
So every time you spin, the machine is way more likely to stop one click short than on the jackpot.
